title: Summarize mixed quarterly feedback (hard)
prompt: Summarize the following in one sentence: Customer feedback this quarter was mixed — satisfaction with product quality rose to 88%, the highest in company history, but satisfaction with shipping times dropped to 61%, the lowest in two years, largely attributed to a carrier change made in month two of the quarter.

metadata.hard_reason: Contains two opposing trends in one update - a lazy summary reports only the positive or only the negative; a correct one needs both, plus the causal note.
metadata.notes: Correct: mentions BOTH the record-high product satisfaction (88%) AND the 2-year-low shipping satisfaction (61%, tied to the carrier change) - dropping either direction is a failure.
metadata.grading_method: required_facts (2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) - zero-cost deterministic presence check, see backend/app/evaluation/required_facts.py. Not an LLM judge. Chosen despite being hard-flagged because the hard part here (don't drop either number) is exactly what presence-checking verifies well - unlike summarization-009/012, which are about correct ATTRIBUTION between two things, not just presence of both.
